description: This PHP source file defines the class EmployeeSubordinateSearchFilterParams, which extends a base FilterParams class and is used to encapsulate search filter parameters specifically for subordinate employee searches within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It includes properties and methods for setting and getting an employee number filter, as well as allowed sort fields.

classes.name: EmployeeSubordinateSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object for subordinate search filters, allowing filtering by employee number and sorting by subordinate's last name.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters object with default sorting by subordinate's last name.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter value.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter value.
